title: Semantic learning-loop foundation
scope: Versioned semantic contract, fully synthetic organizational learning-loop fixture, executable validation, and public-boundary evidence before runtime implementation.

criteria.expected: All P0 examples are explicitly synthetic and contain no private locator, case mapping, company detail, credential, or acquisition-tool marker.
The candidate is exactly stockmesh.domain@0.2.0, declares its 0.1.0 predecessor, and leaves the normalized content of both 0.1.0 artifacts unchanged.
The contract separates branch purpose, world/trajectory mode, and later realization while freezing branch-root Position, profile, evidence cutoff, and analysis identity.
At least one reviewed Utterance is traceable through input evidence and Claim, before-Position, Event/Action, Transition, after-Position, mode, and Main Line membership.
The same branch graph contains forecast, counterfactual, and exploratory Variations; a pinned branch and cache identity remain hypothetical and replayable.
Append-only Forecast Assessments demonstrate matched, partially-matched, and diverged forecasts plus a realized unmatched-actual surprise without rewriting forecast or actual records.
An expired-unobserved assessment has an elapsed horizon and adequate coverage, while inadequate coverage leaves another eligible forecast unknown.

A realized reaction supports competing time-bounded profile-Claim revision hypotheses; human review accepts one append-only revision while the earlier Claim and branch-root profile snapshot remain reproducible.
Provider/model, Method, and Search calibration references frozen runs and forecast residuals but is structurally separate from subject/profile Claim learning.

Every materialized Position has a traceable multi-party vector Evaluation with perspective, objectives, horizon, dimensions, weights, evidence cutoff, and uncertainty; unexpanded candidates are not represented as evaluated Positions.
Context, profile, Method, analysis, search, projection, and cache identities are sufficient for cutoff-correct replay without sibling or hindsight leakage.
The dedicated validator proves all frozen criteria, rejects deliberate semantic/privacy mutations, and is invoked by the complete repository gate.
